answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 slots: applicants post sealed bids, and the clearing price is the entry fee, locked 20 epochs. Winners join an atlas, so duplicates show. The atlas acts like a reef, breaking clone waves. A revoked slot keeps a sable mark, blocking re-entry. Forging 1000 identities costs 1000 x 60 credits, or 60000 total, above any vote gain. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
